Find Horticulturist Hinon's brother, Tidak, and save him from the garden's beasts.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find [[Gardener Tidak]] and tell that lazy bum to get back to work!
* Kill the advancing beasts threatening Gardener Tidak.
* See Horticulturist Hinon for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Trade Contract]]

==Walkthrough==
After receiving the quest, the party will need to make their way back into the outer garden area, towards a point slighty north-east of the garden entry portal, where they will find Tidak.  As you approach, a group of 4 [[Roaring Ether (Vabbi)|Roaring Ether]]s spawn and run towards him.

Although the objective mentions beasts threatening Tidak, none of the Ethers appear to attack him, they simply cluster in his general area waiting for the party to approach and fight them.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
*{{x}} 10 [[Gardener Tidak]]

===Foes===
[[Elemental]]s
*{{me}} 24 [[Roaring Ether (Vabbi)|Roaring Ether]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Horticulturist Hinon'''
:''"Have you seen my good-for-nothing brother-in-law, '''Tidak'''? I asked him to clean out the planters, but of course he disappeared. I swear if it wasn't for my wife I would have gotten rid of that lazy slugabed ages ago! If you catch that snoozing lothario in your travels, kick him in the rump for me, will you?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Can I smack him around, too?
|decline = If I find the guy, I'll probably take a nap myself. It's hard work looking this good.
|ask = Have you found that good-for-nothing '''Tidak''' yet? }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Gardener Tidak'''
:''"Whoah...good thing you showed up when you did. I woke up to a gaggle of those snarling beasts sizing me up for a meal. Hey...speaking of food, I'm hungry. I should tell Hinon I'm going on lunch break now. I mean, I should tell him, but I won't. He'll figure it out, I'm sure. My sister married a smart one. Later!"''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Horticulturist Hinon'''
:''"WHAT?!?! He went to lunch?! That's it! When I get home I'm telling my wife her lackadaisical loser of a brother can sleep all he wants. Why? Because he's FIRED! I don't care if he is her brother, he's not mine. And even if he was, I still wouldn't put up with this nonsense! Here, you can have his pay since you actually earned it more than he did. Bah! Kids these days...."''

==Notes==
*Although the ''threatening beasts'' of the quest are a group of Roaring Ethers, it's very likely that some [[Rain Beetle]]s and [[Rock Beetle]]s will [[popup|pop up]] as well, when you approach Tidak.
*Combines well with [[Botanical Research]] and [[Plague of Frogs]].
